families.label: Energy Production and Processing
families.definition: Exploration, production, processing, refining, equipment support, marketing, and distribution activities across conventional energy supply chains.

capabilities.label: Oil and gas exploration
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to identify, assess, acquire, and test prospects for commercially recoverable petroleum or natural gas resources.

capabilities.label: Crude oil and natural gas production
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to develop, operate, and manage wells and field systems that produce crude oil, natural gas, or associated liquids.

capabilities.label: Petroleum refining
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to process crude oil or intermediate feedstocks into fuels, lubricants, petrochemical feedstocks, and other refined products.

capabilities.label: Fuel marketing and distribution
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to acquire, market, wholesale, distribute, or deliver refined fuels and related energy products to commercial or retail channels.

capabilities.label: Oilfield equipment and services
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to provide equipment, technology, field operations, well services, or technical support used in oil and gas development and production.

families.label: Utility and Midstream Operations
families.definition: Operation of generation, transmission, distribution, storage, terminal, pipeline, and regulated utility systems that deliver energy services.

capabilities.label: Electric power generation
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to own or operate facilities and systems that convert energy resources into electricity for wholesale, retail, or captive use.

capabilities.label: Electric utility operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate regulated or contracted electric transmission, distribution, metering, service, and customer-delivery systems.

capabilities.label: Natural gas utility operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate regulated or contracted natural gas distribution, metering, service, safety, and customer-delivery systems.

capabilities.label: Pipeline transportation
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to own or operate pipeline systems that transport crude oil, natural gas, refined products, water, or other bulk commodities.

capabilities.label: Energy terminal and storage operations
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to operate terminals, tank farms, caverns, gathering assets, or other facilities that receive, store, blend, and transfer energy commodities.

families.label: Mineral and Raw Material Extraction
families.definition: Extraction and primary handling of minerals, stone, sand, aggregates, ores, and other geologic raw materials for industrial use.

capabilities.label: Mineral extraction
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to develop and operate mines or extraction systems that recover metallic, nonmetallic, or industrial minerals from geologic deposits.

capabilities.label: Quarry and aggregate production
capabilities.definition: The organizational ability to extract, crush, screen, grade, and supply stone, sand, gravel, or other aggregate materials for construction or industry.
